t: Titan TTI1257COM cordless 18V combi drill with 73-piece accessory kit. Drill delivers up to 50Nm torque, with drill, hammer, and screwdriver modes to drill through 35mm wood and 13mm steel with ease. Features 2 speeds, 22 torque settings, LED worklight, and a rapid 60min charge time. Kit includes 5m tape measure (width 19mm) with stop button and MID II accuracy; utility knife with 3 blades (SK5); automatic marking pencil and pencil leads; 36mm sockets; countersink drill; centre punch; screwdriver bit holder; various 50mm, 75mm and 25mm screwdriver bits; CK45 steel wood and HSS metal drill bits. Also supplied with Titan TXP 18V battery, charger and carry case.
b: 22 Torque Settings + Drill + Hammer Drill + Screwdriver
